children: KAITO has a scheduled supply unlock in May 2027 for up to 17.6 million tokens, equal to 7.29% of the circulating supply. The release covers allocations for the community, ecosystem, foundation, investors, liquidity and team.
Recipients will be able to sell tokens that were previously locked. If they choose to sell, those tokens can add to the supply on the market and put downward pressure on the price.

title: KAITO: Supply unlock releases up to 17.6 million tokens - May 2027
